info.name: Conflux HQ API
info.description: Complete interactive Postman collection for Conflux HQ (Theme 1: AI Complaint Intelligence & Payment Reconciliation). Supports Local (127.0.0.1:8000), Local Dual Port-Forward (localhost:3000), and Forge Kubernetes Cluster (team10.xtradot.co). Includes automated token cascading, HMAC-SHA256 signature generation, and assertion test scripts.

request.description: Lightweight, zero-database Kubernetes liveness check.
Deep readiness check verifying active database connection.
Full integration health matrix: database, worker queue, intake connectors, social adapter, MaaS investigation, and payment evidence states.
Login as Bank Admin for Zymic Bank demo account. Automatically captures `jwt_token` and `bank_id`.
Bank-admin generation of programmatic API key (cfx_api_...). Automatically captures `machine_api_key`.
List all active machine keys for the bank tenant.
Verifies machine API key (cfx_api_...) authenticates against machine connector health.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 OK with Machine Key', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

Queries immutable provenance audit receipts by payment reference.

request.description: Sends signed XtraDot payment event. Pre-request script dynamically computes HMAC-SHA256 signature using `xtradot_webhook_secret`.
Attempts intake with forged signature. Expects 401 Unauthorized.
Runs deterministic Median Absolute Deviation anomaly detection against complaint volume.
Lists active incidents. Automatically captures `incident_id`.
Returns single payload containing timeline, linked complaints, investigation brief, corrective actions, and audit trail.
Explicit operator trigger queuing MaaS investigation job. Captures `run_id`.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 OK or 202 Accepted', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 202]); });

request.description: Proposes remediation plan in `proposed` state. Captures `ca_id`.

Attempts verification without validation evidence. Enforces tamper-proof rule: expects 400 Bad Request.

exec: pm.test('Status is 400 Bad Request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
